scripts.build:backend-deps: bun run --filter @agentis-hq/core build && bun run --filter @agentis-hq/sdk build
scripts.backend:start: bun run build:backend-deps && cd apps/backend && bun run index.ts
scripts.build:packages: bun run --filter @agentis-hq/core build && bun run --filter @agentis-hq/sdk build && bun run --filter @agentis-hq/cli build && bun run --filter @agentis-hq/mcp build
scripts.check:packages: bun run build:packages && bun run --filter @agentis-hq/cli check && bun run --filter @agentis-hq/mcp check
scripts.check: bun run check:packages && bun run --filter backend check && bun run --filter next-app check
scripts.test:unit: bun test packages/sdk/src packages/mcp/src packages/cli/src packages/core/src apps/backend/src/modules/payment-http.test.ts apps/backend/src/modules/usd-budget.test.ts apps/next-app/components/amount-input.test.ts apps/next-app/components/operation-authorization.test.ts
scripts.test: bun run build:packages && bun run test:unit && bun run test:backend
